title: 2026 UK CBAM effective carbon price calculation QA controls

sources.title: Work out your Carbon Price Relief
What you need to work out Carbon Price Relief

facts.source_fact: Carbon Price Relief calculation starts with an effective carbon price.
The verification form must cover one of the two calendar years before the import year.
Total installation emissions are taken from the verification form.
Emissions are apportioned across applicable carbon-pricing elements.
Free allowances and zero-priced thresholds are excluded from priced components.
facts.expected_handling: Do not assign a positive price to zero-priced components.

facts.source_fact: Compensation, refunds and rebates are applied after the initial effective-price calculation.
Relief equals effective carbon price multiplied by embodied emissions subject to the qualifying scheme.
Relief is calculated separately for each CBAM good.
Foreign-currency relief must be converted to GBP using HMRC-published exchange rates.
Total relief cannot exceed the CBAM liability due.
